title: PL24 Adoption at 55% — Lowest in C1 Europe territory

No formal onboarding to PL24 or AOS completed. Without tool proficiency the new parts manager defaults to the methods used by the previous incumbent.
impact: +€8400/month if PL24 adoption reaches regional average of 81%

title: DB Margin at 17.8% — Pricing discipline failure
rootCause: Counter staff are discounting beyond authorised levels to compete with non-OEM suppliers. No manager approval currently required for discounts under 5%. Three instances identified in the last 30 days of discounts exceeding the threshold without principal sign-off. Cumulative margin erosion is significant.

title: Part Family Coverage at 10/18 — 8 families unconfigured
rootCause: Kai Fischer was unaware that the AOS basket requires regular updating to reflect the local car park profile. High-demand families for the Frankfurt market (E-series, G-series, X-series) are not in the basket. Staff are placing manual orders for these families, bypassing both PL24 and AOS entirely.
impact: +€6700/month if basket aligned to Frankfurt car park demand
